description: Fields present in every JSON record.

v.description: Version of the schema. Increased only on breaking changes.
v.title: V

fw.description: Firmware version (optionally containing the git commit hash)
fw.title: Fw

boot.description: Boot counter, stored on flash memory of the microcontroller.
boot.title: Boot

seq.description: Sequence number per boot. (dev, boot, seq) is the unique key for dedup (QoS 1, SD replay) and gap detection.
seq.title: Seq

up.description: Monotonic seconds since boot, ms resolution. Time of measurement/event, not of sending. Use for intervals: ts may jump on re-sync.
up.title: Up

ts.description: Unix seconds UTC after NTP sync, captured together with up. null while unsynced; key is mandatory.
ts.title: Ts

title: RecordHeader
